claims.claim: The HTML img element represents an image, and its src attribute supplies the image resource address.
The alt attribute supplies replacement text when an image is unavailable and an appropriate text alternative depends on the image's purpose and context.
A decorative image that conveys no information should use a null alternative, alt="".
For a functional image such as an image link or button, the alternative should identify the function rather than merely describe the picture.
The width and height attributes express an image's horizontal and vertical dimensions; providing both lets a browser reserve space using the image's aspect ratio while it loads.
Text alternatives can make image information available to people using screen readers or Braille output.
